engine.label: Piper Kristin medium split decoder · planSegments · 4 threads
engine.streaming: libpiper split voice: one encoder pass per part, then overlapping decoder chunks, so audio is incremental within a sentence; full mode drains the same chunks into one
engine.chunkPolicy: planSegments: first part is the first clause or 4 words of sentence 1, then whole sentences; chunks are libpiper's decoder chunks (first 32 latent frames, 372 ms, 12 context frames each side, later 24 to 256 frames sized from decoder speed), untrimmed, no added gaps
engine.cancellation: between decoder chunks in the worker (no stop request yet; a host stops by not sending the next part, the current part runs to completion)

loadDetail.note: loadMs is the Piper Plus frontend (CMU dict parse) plus worker spawn and piper_create (encoder and decoder sessions)
